shortDescription: The "Over" option in Polymarket's "Atlanta Braves vs. Los Angeles Dodgers" submarket "O/U 8.5" fell sharply to 21.5% from 36.5% one hour earlier, a 15% swing. According to ChainCatcher, the move was tracked by Catcher Predict monitoring and may reflect the impact of breaking news.
